title: Blue Skies

evidence.note: IMSLP's catalog entry lists the original sheet-music publisher info as 'New York: Irving Berlin Inc., 1927'. Berlin wrote the song in late 1926 (dated December 16, 1926) as a last-minute addition to the musical Betsy, but it was copyrighted/published in 1927, which Wikipedia's article text also states ('In 1927, the music was published').
The University of Wisconsin-Madison Mills Music Library sheet-music catalog lists the original edition as published 'New York: Irving Berlin', dated 1927.

famous_use: Performed by Al Jolson in The Jazz Singer (1927), one of the first feature films with synchronized sound ('talkies').
